pass_definition: a judge passes a pair when every event_<i> probability >= event_min, the unlisted probability < unlisted_max, the chosen route equals the claimed route and its probability >= route_min; an error, a refusal or a malformed answer never passes
chosen_on: thresholds and rule: calibration half of data/scribe/v3/judges/pairs-v1.jsonl; the v2 question set was designed after the v1 results of both halves had been seen (see question_sets.disclosure in the benchmark)
